name: Publix Distribution Campus Lakeland FL (County Line)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Street View (pano 72xVFOCkwfKwy1yeLvc21w, 2023-12): staffed island guard booth straddling the entry road with raised barrier-arm mechanisms and bollards on both lanes; PRIVATE PROPERTY / NO TRESPASSING signage. Visible as a small green-roofed structure straddling the drive in z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Same pano shows a guard in uniform (blue shirt, clipboard) standing at the booth window; classic 1-vehicle-footprint booth with windows on multiple sides set in the center of the entry road island.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single controlled entry complex off the County Line Rd access road; in-lane and out-lane pass either side of the central booth at one point of the property line.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Island booth with one lane each side; counted 1 inbound, low confidence from imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 outbound lane past the booth island.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron approaching the booth with room either side; gate island layout leaves unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron and internal yard between the guard booth and the dock faces gives ample inside-the-gate queuing room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from County Line Rd across the pond causeway to the gate, then a deep internal yard before the docks; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door rhythm runs the full length of BOTH the north and south building faces (building is ~600 m long). Estimated ~180 total doors across both faces; 50+ band. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on the east end (z17/z18 eyard imagery) hold dozens of bobtail trailers; well into 50+ across the yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite (north and south) building faces, consistent with separate shipping vs receiving operations on a HV/LV warehouse.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated east-end trailer storage lot full of parked trailers, separate from the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor SW of Lakeland; property is an island ringed by retention ponds and woods, surrounded by other large DCs but not dense metro fabric. Judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is large and partly tree-ringed but sits in an active industrial corridor near I-4 / US-92; cellular coverage likely adequate. Low-confidence inference, marked false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate of dedicated drop-yard stall capacity (~90) from east-yard rows; overhead estimate, low confidence.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Count of trailers visible across captured imagery (docks + drop yard + north/south rows); ~140, approximate.
